materiality_boundary.description: A transfer with full symmetric attestation and no scope widening is still material at proposal time; materiality governs, not outcome.

accountability_transfer.rationale: A transition that changes who is answerable for the system's next consequential act -- control handoff or delegation to autonomy.

irreversible_external_effect_above_appro.rationale: Retained from the base profile; not exercised by this register.

material_information_barrier_breach.rationale: Retained from the base profile; not exercised by this register.

material_statutory_prohibition.rationale: Retained from the base profile; not exercised by this register.

materiality_boundary.description: Reversibility-qualified per Section VII-A: harm that is self-limiting and requires no intervention does not enter C* on its class alone. Enforced directly by gcir.coverage.CStarProfile.evaluate()'s required_reversibility check, not by a materiality workaround.

physical_harm_to_person.rationale: Physical harm to a patient arising from a mediated transition (instrument activation, energy delivery) that is not self-limiting.

materiality_boundary.description: Export within consent scope is below the boundary by definition, not by materiality.

protected_data_disclosure_outside_consen.rationale: Intraoperative video/telemetry export outside the recorded consent scope.

materiality_boundary.description: An unauthorized act with no external effect is below the boundary.

unauthorized_authority_exercise.rationale: Actuation or autonomous subtask entry without identifiable supervisory authority is the system exercising authority it does not hold.
